limitations: LinuxCNC rs274 standalone-interpreter acceptance verifies RS274NGC interpretation and canonical-function lowering for the recorded NC/tool-table/metric-machine fixture; it is not physical machine authorization.
The verification does not execute realtime motion, HAL, servo loops, actual machine kinematics, spindle/toolchanger hardware, fixtures, holders, clamp loads, or material cutting.
Tool-table Z offsets are zero and diameters are the nominal portfolio tools; production offsets remain setup/tool-table responsibility.
G54 is zero in the standalone verification environment; physical work-offset establishment remains a setup/metrology obligation.
Successful interpreter acceptance does not establish feeds/speeds, workholding, collision clearance, part quality, or physical process capability.
